reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: PBMC activation, clonal spike-in noise model and replicate/condition/pathway tests of discordance.

checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult and transfer prior primary Methods or validated protocols before execution. Calibration alone is not this action.
Essential stimulation, sampling, staining and preparation settings are deferred; no quantitative source/calibration-to-setting procedure makes the primary workflow executable.
Model families and contrasts are named but the primary likelihood/assumptions, diagnostics and multiplicity procedure remain unspecified.
Technical repair does not explicitly require a revised frozen procedure and fresh independent confirmatory data after changes.
No complete immutable input manifest, exact software/environment/settings and command-to-output provenance chain is specified.
No clean-environment rerun with numerical figure outputs, declared tolerances, resource/failure logs and source-difference audit is planned.

checks.quote: essentially all observed variance is technical
checks.reason: Clonal steady-state cells retain biological transcription, protein and cell-cycle heterogeneity. Treating their entire variance as technical creates an invalid null calibration; a second cell line does not repair that premise.

The stated positive-tail threshold misses large negative residuals despite claiming both RNA-high/protein-low and protein-high/RNA-low calls. A two-sided calibrated endpoint is not supplied consistently.

The 75 discordant cells are not the total binomial denominator or independent donor count; 75 per group also does not give the claimed power for 5% versus 10%. Increasing cell yield cannot substitute for biological-unit power.

Fixed within-sample tail removal and mitochondrial cutoff can preferentially remove activated biological states. No control-derived failure validation or complete attrition/denominator policy protects those outcomes.

checks.quote: applied per sample to avoid batch effects
checks.reason: Per-sample CLR is not a guarantee of removing batch effects; size-factor/CLR and regression assumptions and limitations are not correctly developed into a justified transformation strategy.

Replicate consistency, enrichment and time association alone do not establish the stated post-transcriptional mechanism or information unavailable to either modality alone. Orthogonal mechanistic validation is deferred.

checks.quote: A flat profile across conditions supports Mechanism B.
checks.reason: Biological discordance can be stable across these conditions. A flat trajectory or disappearance after decontamination cannot alone establish technical origin; the negative decision lacks effect-size equivalence and calibrated sensitivity.
Primary confirmation is same-donor split-library consistency; orthogonal functional follow-up is only suggested for an ambiguous result, not committed as a validating experiment for the main claim.
No independent donor test split with noise/typing/feature/model fitting contained in discovery folds is specified. The same observations define discordance and test its transcriptomic enrichment.
No bounded depth/missingness/normalization robustness challenge preserving biological discordance is specified; observational technical-covariate regression is not that stress test.

explanation_reason: Substantial design detail, but a biologically variable clonal null, incorrect power denominator and observational mechanism claims materially weaken the study.
historical_match_reason: The biological value of complementary RNA/protein measurements is recognized, but the chosen direction is discordance kinetics and mechanism. It does not propose local cell-specific predictive modality weights, adaptive multimodal neighborhoods, a matched single/fixed/adaptive comparison or the corresponding held-out integration gain. A valid alternative biological study earns scientific credit, not the sealed integration-direction hit.
